# netbox_cooling_source (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox cooling source (`/api/dcim/cooling-sources/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_cooling_source" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_cooling_source" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/cooling-sources/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `cooling_capacity` (Number) Total rated cooling capacity (kW).
- `coolingfeed_count` (Number) Coolingfeed Count.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `fluid_type` (String) Fluid Type. Valid values: `water`, `water-glycol`, `dielectric`, `refrigerant`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the Location (`netbox_location`).
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the Site (`netbox_site`).
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `offline`, `active`, `planned`, `failed`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `type` (String) Type. Valid values: `chiller`, `cooling-tower`, `dry-cooler`, `crac`, `crah`.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
